mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id, u_sender.username AS sender_name, u_getter.username AS getter_name, o.title, o.content, o.type, o.sender_price, o.deposit, o.state, o.document_path, o.user_complete, o.auditor_complete, o.release_datetime, o.end_datetime, o.complete_datetime, o.update_datetime, o.pay_state, o.deposit_state FROM t_order o LEFT JOIN t_user u_sender ON o.sender_id = u_sender.user_id LEFT JOIN t_user u_getter ON o.getter_id = u_getter.user_id WHERE o.user_complete='1' AND o.state='1' ORDER BY o.release_datetime DESC
